projects.title: Synchronous Buck Converter for a CubeSat Power Board
bullets: Raised peak efficiency from 85% to 92% at 2 A on an electronic load by replacing the catch diode with a synchronous MOSFET and tuning dead time in 10 ns steps on an STM32 timer
Brought output ripple down from 80 mV to 25 mV peak to peak on the oscilloscope by moving to a 4-layer KiCad layout with a solid ground plane and a smaller switching loop, simulated in LTspice
Wrote overcurrent shutdown firmware in C that trips in under 50 µs, tested on 20 shorts

projects.title: FPGA Audio Equalizer
bullets: Built a 5-band equalizer in Verilog for 48 kHz stereo audio with under 2 ms of latency
Kept the response within 0.5 dB of the MATLAB reference from 20 Hz to 20 kHz by testing 16-bit fixed-point coefficients in Vivado simulation before loading the design onto a Basys 3 board

projects.title: Bluetooth Battery Monitor
bullets: Built an ESP32 monitor that streams 4 cell voltages to a Python dashboard over Bluetooth
Calibrated an INA219 current sensor to within 1% of a bench meter from 0.1 A to 3 A
Stretched field-test runtime 18% with a C++ cutoff that drops extra loads at 3.3 V per cell

experience.title: Power Subsystem Lead
bullets: Saved 40 g on the power board by swapping 3 linear regulators for 1 buck converter
Caught 2 battery protection faults before launch review with a Python script that ran overnight charge and discharge cycles on a bench supply and flagged any cell that drifted more than 20 mV
Run weekly design reviews for the 4-person power team
